project.name: Ledgerly
project.description: Invented example. Ledgerly is a made-up invoicing app for design studios and freelance designers. The team wants to learn what to build next and how to talk about it.

pools.about: Bugs, missing features and friction. Serves the backlog.
What customers want, how they decide, and the words they use. Serves messaging and the website.
Pricing, objections and reasons to switch. Serves pricing and the sales pitch.

segments.about: Design studios and agencies with a team.
